versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UAV Design and Construction
versions.text:
(a) If compliance with the reserve energy absorption requirements in USAR.723 (b) is shown by free drop tests, the drop height may not be less than 1.44 times that specified in USAR.725.
(b) If the effect of wing lift is provided for, the units must be dropped with an effective mass equal to Me = M (h / [h + d]) when the symbols and other details are the same as in USAR.725.
